verdict.rationale: Mailchimp documents revenue attribution beyond opens/clicks via 'Analytics AI' explaining which campaigns and automations move revenue (mailchimp-docs-25), e-commerce integrations that measure campaign ROI (mailchimp-docs-23), and conversion-funnel insights (mailchimp-docs-12), but standard reporting is still framed mainly around open/click rates (mailchimp-docs-21, mailchimp-docs-22) and there's no explicit documentation of signup-level attribution tied to specific flows. Missing for 10: dedicated signup-attribution reporting per flow/automation, and independent/hands-on confirmation that Analytics AI attribution works as described.
